def preprocess_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text) or text is None:
        return ""
    try:
        text = str(text).lower().strip()
    except:
        return ""

    cleaned = []
    literary_punct = [".", "-", "/", '"', "'", "?", "!", ":", ";"]
    for char in text:
        if char.isalpha() or char in literary_punct or char == " ":
            cleaned.append(char)

    cleaned = "".join(cleaned)
    cleaned = " ".join(cleaned.split())
    return cleaned
